description: LEP Siedlung 2006 Eisenbahn is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Strongly generalized linear representation of the railway connections within the framework of the Land Development Plan Settlement. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "LEP Settlement 2006 Railway" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Planungsunterlagen/Kataster, geoportal, Saarland. The listing shows 2010-10-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
